```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
con = DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
flights_tbl = copy_to(con, nycflights13::flights, "flights", temporary = FALSE)
planes_tbl = copy_to(con, nycflights13::planes, "planes", temporary = FALSE)
```

```{python py_setup}
#| include: false
import polars as pl
flights = pl.scan_parquet("../data/flights.parquet")
planes = pl.scan_parquet("../data/planes.parquet")
```


# Exercise 1

Using `flights_tbl` and `planes_tbl`, find the most common destination from each origin, the five manufacturers with the most flights along with their mean departure delay, and the manufacturers with at least 30,000 flights. Inspect the SQL for each with `show_query()`.

```{r}
q1 = flights_tbl |>
  count(origin, dest) |>
  filter(n == max(n, na.rm = TRUE), .by = origin) |>
  arrange(origin)

q1
show_query(q1)
```

```{r}
q2 = flights_tbl |>
  inner_join(planes_tbl, by = "tailnum") |>
  summarize(n = n(), delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE), .by = manufacturer) |>
  arrange(desc(n)) |>
  head(5)

q2
show_query(q2)
```

```{r}
q3 = flights_tbl |>
  inner_join(planes_tbl, by = "tailnum") |>
  summarize(n = n(), delay = mean(dep_delay, na.rm = TRUE), .by = manufacturer) |>
  filter(n >= 30000) |>
  arrange(desc(n))

q3
show_query(q3)
```


# Exercise 2

Repeat the three questions from Exercise 1 using `pl.sql()` with the `flights` and `planes` LazyFrames.

```{python}
pl.sql("""
  WITH counts AS (
    SELECT origin, dest, COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY origin, dest
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT *, MAX(n) OVER (PARTITION BY origin) AS max_n
    FROM counts
  )
  SELECT origin, dest, n
  FROM ranked
  WHERE n = max_n
  ORDER BY origin
""").collect()
```

```{python}
pl.sql("""
  SELECT p.manufacturer, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(f.dep_delay) AS delay
  FROM flights f
  JOIN planes p ON f.tailnum = p.tailnum
  GROUP BY p.manufacturer
  ORDER BY n DESC
  LIMIT 5
""").collect()
```

```{python}
pl.sql("""
  SELECT p.manufacturer, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(f.dep_delay) AS delay
  FROM flights f
  JOIN planes p ON f.tailnum = p.tailnum
  GROUP BY p.manufacturer
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30000
  ORDER BY n DESC
""").collect()
```
